component.name: Faro
component.summary: Synchronize media playback across multiple media players over the Internet

description.p: Faro synchronises the position and play state of multiple media players so that viewers can watch the same thing at the same time. Pausing, resuming, seeking, and changing playback speed are replicated across players connected to the same room.

Room owners and moderators can ban people, so they can't rejoin with the same invite until the ban is lifted. Roles, removal and bans now sit behind compact menus in the people panel. A file a friend has can be played before it is shared. Live broadcasts show at their live edge, and their chat tab closes with them. The chat toolbar and long messages now fit a narrow window.

Makes shared files stream reliably: stalled or trickling transfers restart on their own, failures retry with backoff, playback continues from the cache when sharing ends, and a corrupted-bytes race in capped caches is fixed. Playback switching, closing and reconnecting no longer let an older action override a newer one. Live streams no longer trip the room's command limit, share only play and pause, and show their YouTube chat in a separate tab. VLC now shows video in its own window, and Faro asks whether to keep running in the tray the first time its window closes.

Picks the best installed media player automatically, adds a Browse button for the player executable, refuses to join without a usable player, reports a missing yt-dlp or JavaScript runtime for YouTube links, removes a stutter when first opening Host room, and updates dependencies.

Allows room owners and moderators to remove participants, automatically reopens dismissed players when others start playback, suspends wheel audio when idle, and pins the AppImage runtime to a tagged release.
Installs updates in place and checks for them periodically, adds a "Don't ask again" option to the quit dialog, and fixes starting mpv or VLC installed with Scoop on Windows.
Redesigns the selection wheel, makes the selected tab easier to see in the light and sage themes, and introduces a new app icon.
Adds faster cached streaming, chat over video in mpv, playback and queue improvements, a system tray option, and more reliable connections across platforms.
Fixes playlist and wheel-spin playback, hardens streaming with a cached media gateway, and adds new themes and queue context menus.
